findings.title: Bind critical Transformer pins to the selected package root before real load
findings.evidence: The gate accepts any runtime_files entry ending in transformers/generation/utils.py (and the other required suffixes). It does not derive the expected path from module_origins[transformers]. Therefore an unrelated second package tree can satisfy the critical-source pin gate while the selected top-level package imports an unpinned critical file. The shipped pending descriptor currently uses one consistent overlay root, so this is an acceptance gap for future completed selections rather than evidence of a mismatched current file.
findings.required_before_execution: Root must explicitly verify every critical source pin belongs to the actual selected transformers package root, or a new separately frozen revision must require exact root-derived paths and test the mixed-root case. Do not claim the generic loader gate itself proves this binding.
